string-array.item: OMG! Did you hear about the new ACOTAR book?
I did!!! It\'s going to be released on Oct 27th, right?
Yes! I\'m excited to read it, but I have a LOT of assignments to submit before that date
Ugh me too. I also have to go through my midterms next week 🫠
At least you\'ll have something relaxing to focus on after that
Wait... Don\'t you have a half marathon next weekend??? 🫪
I do!!! I\'m so excited but at the same time terrified
Girl, you trained really hard. You\'re going to rock your race 🏃🏻‍♀️
I\'ll be there cheering for you! 💛
